15-3/4 Inch Barn Door Ladder Pulls

This back to back pair of contemporary Ladder Pulls is great for barn doors. Nice size 1' diameter pull handle with clean lines give it a modern feel that is easy to grip. Made from heavy gauge 304 stainless steel tubing with a Brushed finish.

Specifications and Features 15-3/4 Inch Barn Door Ladder Pulls:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel Tubing
  • Overall Length: 15-3/4" (400 mm)
  • Length: 11-13/16" center to center (300 mm)
  • Handle Diameter: 1" (25 mm)
  • Mounting Post Diameter: 22/32" (18 mm)
  • Overall Projection: 2-3/4"
  • Clearance: 1-3/4"
  • Door Thickness: 1" to 2-1/4" Thick Doors
  • Pair, Back-to-back mounting.
  • Finish: Brushed Nickel




*Item Discontinued. See available Door Pulls
